chapter: Clarinet fingering and the Tio family
title: Method books and continued lessons with several teachers
summary: He used the Klose method and others, and kept taking lessons with his sister, Lorenzo Tio, Papa Tio and another teacher.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: I wondered about your lessons when Lorenzo Teo helped you. Did you have a method book or how did you learn?
Yeah, well I did. I had a closed-air. That's a method. I started with a closed-air.
But I had a couple of others.
I just used them. I gave a couple of them away. I used a closed-air and I used a fool with this method. You see, that's where I was living. stuff with stuff with
when I moved from, you see.
1726 Fern Street. Fern Street, yeah. Because this is one of the late David Gornston methods. I've seen them.
Yeah, and I had this other auto language.
Oh, yes, that's a good method.

Well, I had that and I had close ears. I had this and I have another one. But that close ears, that's a very, very good method. If you go through that close ears, Papa, you got some stuff in there. You go through that, you got your enough stuff. You can play. You can go out and play. You don't have to be afraid. I think it was one of the best that I looked at. Between him and between the close ears, I took a line as I would know which one to take. Oh, very good. Yeah.
How long did you take lessons from T.O.? You said in about six months you could play. Well, I took lessons on instrument to start playing.

Then I continued my lessons after music. Yes, you kept on going. Yeah, I continued taking music lessons. Then I had music lessons. I took music lessons with my sister. I took music lessons with T.O. I took music lessons with old man Chalini.
